title: Xtra power Triple Suction Cup Glass Lifter, Heavy Duty Vacuum Puller Tool, for Tile, Granite, Windshield, Mirror, Glass Panels, Industrial-Grade
description: The Xtra power Triple Suction Cup Glass Lifter is a heavy-duty vacuum puller tool designed for professionals and DIY enthusiasts who need reliable lifting power for large, smooth surfaces. Featuring three industrial-grade suction cups, this lifter provides exceptional grip strength and stability when handling tile, granite, windshields, mirrors, and glass panels. The triple suction design distributes weight evenly across three points, allowing you to lift and manoeuvre heavy materials with confidence and control. Each suction cup creates a powerful vacuum seal on smooth, non-porous surfaces, making it ideal for installation work, glass replacement, and material handling tasks. The robust construction ensures durability in demanding work environments, whilst the ergonomic handle design allows for comfortable operation during extended use. Whether you're a glazier, tiler, or construction professional, this vacuum puller tool helps reduce the risk of damage to expensive materials and makes solo lifting tasks more manageable. Perfect for workshops, construction sites, and renovation projects where secure handling of large glass and stone surfaces is essential.
